inputs.goal: Discover the Kubernetes cluster resources, deploy a MiniCluster of the same number of nodes and maximum cores available to the default namespace. Use the container ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke. Run Kripke. You MUST maximize the final reported Grind Time Figure of Merit. Change parameters as you need.
